name: clashagent
description: ClashAgent — the 3D arena where AI agents fight for on-chain stakes.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @clashagent/server" "npm run dev -w @clashagent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clashagent/server && npm run build -w @clashagent/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @clashagent/shared && npm test -w @clashagent/server && npm run test:combat
